name: matrix_feedback
description: Edit only instruction using its parent whole-prompt confusion matrix.
both: Edit the strategy for examining evidence and choosing among the supplied labels. Do not output task definitions, label definitions, examples, or the complete classification template. Feedback describes the whole parent combination, not this component alone. It cannot identify which component caused errors; treat edits as hypotheses. Consider row totals when interpreting error counts. Combine the two target components, then mutate the combination. Return exactly {"crossover": VALUE, "value": VALUE}.
crossover_only: Edit the strategy for examining evidence and choosing among the supplied labels. Do not output task definitions, label definitions, examples, or the complete classification template. Feedback describes the whole parent combination, not this component alone. It cannot identify which component caused errors; treat edits as hypotheses. Consider row totals when interpreting error counts. Combine the two target components without a separate mutation. Return exactly {"crossover": VALUE}.
mutation_only: Edit the strategy for examining evidence and choosing among the supplied labels. Do not output task definitions, label definitions, examples, or the complete classification template. Feedback describes the whole parent combination, not this component alone. It cannot identify which component caused errors; treat edits as hypotheses. Consider row totals when interpreting error counts. Mutate only the supplied first-parent target component. Return exactly {"value": VALUE}.
